description: This Java class manages and monitors the connection state within an application, tracking whether the system is connected, loading, or not connected. It integrates event listeners for engine timing, sensor updates, and message reception to determine connection status and provides mechanisms to execute actions once connected.

classes.name: ConnectionStatus
classes.description: Manages connection state, listening to engine time, sensor updates, and messages to update connection status and notify listeners.

methods.name: executeOnceConnected
methods.description: Executes a runnable once the connection is established, or attaches a listener to execute upon connection.

methods.name: markConnected
methods.description: Marks the connection as active, switching status to LOADING and restarting the timer.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the connection status value and notifies registered listeners if the status changes.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns true if the system is currently connected.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current connection status value.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to be notified of connection status changes.
